correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 and cyclic unit normals with every angular gap in (0,pi), write edges e_i=x_(i+1)-x_i=λ_i Ja_i+μ_i Ja_(i+1) with λ_i,μ_i>=0. Rotating edge sectors cover one full turn; each support projection is monotone decreasing then increasing along a closed walk, so all nonadjacent inequalities follow from the two adjacent ones. Translation quotient is B=R_+^(2n)∩ker([t_0,t_1,t_1,t_2,...,t_(n-1),t_0]), with rank-two closure. Strict positive point x_i=a_i and transfer between duplicate tangent columns witness each of 2n distinct facets. Positive minimal dependencies of planar nonzero tangent directions have either an antipodal pair or an origin-surrounding triple; their 4/8 occurrence choices and sine-coefficient relation exhaust all extreme supports. For n regular, counting strict three-direction gaps yields T_odd=n(n²−1)/24 and T_even=n(n−2)(n−4)/24; 8T plus 2n rays in even case. Independent integer combinatorial enumeration for n=3..12 agrees with formula; arbitrary n follows from circuit proof and counting, not those samples.
residual_risks: No facet/ray conclusion for normal gaps >=pi; quotient by translations is essential; regular-grid closed counts do not apply to arbitrary angles. Floating-point tests do not certify universal statements.
